raw_block.rationale: Create a reusable baggage calculator with a single aligned current-source read. It computes allowance assignment from raw dimensions, applies ordinal base fees, selects route-specific weight and size charges, and uses the policy's higher-excess-fee rule. This directly addresses the failed 3010 parent and can also preserve or improve the related airline history parent.
